rows: Set the change-over switch (43) type BH-H7 for testing protection (a27S) to the Test position on the protection cell.
Remove the outer cover on the relay and clean the relay with an air blower, cleaning the two relay connection plugs to the voltage transformer.
Insert Test plug type HP2-P4 into Test socket type HR2A-P4 for relay (a27S) on the protection cell.
Set the Normal-Test switch on the relay to Test for phase R, to test R-S.
Inject voltage at points (21, 22) on the Test Plug.
Raise the voltage to a value above the setting value, 75 V.
Reduce the voltage until the indication appears on the relay.
Switch off the voltage injection test set.
Return the Normal-Test switch on the relay for phase R to the Normal position.
Set the Normal-Test switch on the relay to Test for phase S, to test S-T.
Inject voltage at points (22, 23) on the Test Plug.
Raise the voltage to a value above the setting value, 75 V.
Reduce the voltage until the indication appears on the relay.
Switch off the voltage injection test set.
Return the Normal-Test switch on the relay for phase S to the Normal position.
Set the Normal-Test switch on the relay to Test for phase T, to test T-R.
Inject voltage at points (21, 23) on the Test plug.
Raise the voltage to a value above the setting value, 75 V.
Reduce the voltage until the indication appears on the relay.
Switch off the voltage injection test set.
Return the Normal-Test switch on the relay for phase T to the Normal position.
Fit the glass cover on the relay.
Remove Test Plug type HP2-P4 from the Test Socket of the protection cell.
Set the change-over switch (43) type BH-H7 for testing protection (a27S) to the Normal position on the protection cell.

Introduction

Safety Precautions
Isolate all switches connected to the busbars to be tested.
Open the work order.
Fence off the work area.
Place the necessary warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.

AC V-A voltage measuring instrument, model Yokogawa
Test plug, model HP2-P4
Test leads
